calibration.note: The end-of-day 78,774.0 reduce gate FIRED, on the settled 04:00 UTC hourly close of 78,680.1, 93.9 points through the trigger, and it has been confirmed by three lower closes since - 78,588.3, 78,323.2 and an in-progress 78,412.2. The 79,430.0 add gate correctly REFUSED: the session high of 79,485.9 poked 55.9 points above it at 01:00 UTC but the candle SETTLED at 78,935.5, and no hourly close since has come within 400 points. The 78,682.0 invalidation was breached on the 05:00 UTC hour. So the gates were mechanically right and the direction was right. The discretionary side was not: end of day spent 8 of its 32.66 USDT at 79,159.7 on the reading that open interest had fallen 1.46 percent, and price marks 78,426.2 - the tranche is 733.5 points offside, -0.93 percent, for roughly -0.074 USDT. Its own stated risk is exactly what happened; it wrote that a 1.46 percent open-interest drop on a flat tape could be positions closing ahead of the Tuesday ETF reopen rather than a real unwind, and open interest has since rebuilt 1.25 percent straight through a 528,247 USD long flush. The 24.66 USDT it held back is the reason a correct diagnosis and a wrong entry only cost seven hundredths of a dollar.
